examples.japanese: {親|おや}に{相談|そうだん}する。
{親|おや}の{言|い}うことを{聞|き}きなさい。
examples.english: Listen to what your parents say.
We went out as parent and child.

notes:
{親|おや} means 'parent' (can refer to one or both parents).

Family terms:
- {父|ちち}/{母|はは}: father/mother (humble, about own)
- お{父|とう}さん/お{母|かあ}さん: father/mother (polite, about others)
- {両親|りょうしん}: both parents (formal)

Common compounds:
- {親|おや}{子|こ}: parent and child
- {親|おや}{友|とも}: close friend
- {親|おや}{会社|がいしゃ}: parent company
- {親|おや}{指|ゆび}: thumb (parent finger)
- {親切|しんせつ}: kindness

Note: {親|おや} is the generic/casual term. In formal contexts or when referring to someone else's parents, use ご{両親|りょうしん}.
